title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Summer Superdrop 2025
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: The Summer Superdrop 2025 is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on June 9, 2025 and sold out within a day.

Adjacent to the Final Fantasy release, this superdrop contains three Final Fantasy -themed drops, each with artwork depicting characters, spells, and weapons from across the Final Fantasy video franchise. Each of these drops will be available in non-foil and rainbow foil in limited quantities. Additionally, these drops will be printed in English and Japanese. Each card in these drops features a "game identifier" in the information below the text box , identifying the specific FF video game that its art and mechanics relate to.
Purchasers of Final Fantasy bundles receive a rainbow foil Gilded Lotus promo card with the purchase while supplies last. The card is illustrated by Kasia 'Kafis' Zielińska.
